conditions.label: Has employees
conditions.description: Pays wages or salaries and runs a payroll.

conditions.label: Registered for VAT
conditions.description: Registered for value added tax or a similar turnover tax.

profileFields.label: Company name
profileFields.description: The registered name, including the CC legal form. A close corporation owned by a small number of members.

profileFields.label: Company registration number
profileFields.description: The number the company register gave the company.

profileFields.label: Registered office address
profileFields.description: The address on the company register.

profileFields.label: Share capital
profileFields.description: The capital the company was registered with. Leave it empty if the form has no share capital.

roles.label: Director
roles.description: Runs the company and represents it.

roles.label: Shareholder
roles.description: Owns shares or a stake in the company.

setupSteps.title: Choose and check the CC name
setupSteps.description: Check the name is free in Companies and Intellectual Property Authority and follows Eswatini's naming rules.

setupSteps.title: Prepare the CC documents
setupSteps.description: Prepare the articles or statutes, the founders' details and the registered office. The registration process sets out what it needs. The Companies and Intellectual Property Authority (CIPA) website did not resolve when checked; the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Trade publishes the registration procedure on the Eswatini Trade Information Portal.

setupSteps.title: Register the CC
setupSteps.description: Submit the incorporation documents as Companies and Intellectual Property Authority requires. The company exists once the register enters it.

setupSteps.title: Register the CC for tax
setupSteps.description: Register with Eswatini Revenue Service for the company's tax number and any VAT or payroll accounts it needs.

setupSteps.title: Register as an employer
setupSteps.description: Before the first hire, register with Eswatini Revenue Service for payroll and social contributions.

setupSteps.title: Open a business bank account
setupSteps.description: Banks usually ask for the registration certificate and the tax number.

setupSteps.title: Check licences for your activity
setupSteps.description: Some activities need a permit or a licence from a sector regulator. Check before you start trading.

obligations.title: Annual return or confirmation statement
obligations.description: Check whether an annual return or confirmation statement is due with Companies and Intellectual Property Authority, then file it and keep the company record current.

obligations.title: Annual financial statements
obligations.description: Prepare the annual accounts. Check whether they must be filed with Companies and Intellectual Property Authority, the deadline and whether an audit is required.

obligations.title: Corporate income tax return
obligations.description: Check the company's income tax filing with Eswatini Revenue Service, then file the return and pay by the dates it sets.

obligations.title: VAT returns
obligations.description: File VAT returns with Eswatini Revenue Service and pay any VAT due. Check whether the company is registered and how often it files.

obligations.title: Payroll taxes and social contributions
obligations.description: Withhold and remit payroll taxes and social contributions for employees through Eswatini Revenue Service. Check the rates and dates.

obligations.title: Beneficial ownership information
obligations.description: Check whether the country requires a beneficial ownership filing. If it does, keep the record up to date and file it with Companies and Intellectual Property Authority.

obligations.title: Report changes to the register
obligations.description: Check what changes must be reported to Companies and Intellectual Property Authority, then tell it about changes to the name, address, directors or share capital within its deadline.

obligations.title: Renew licences and permits
obligations.description: Check which licences your activity needs and renew them before they expire.
